title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 1–50 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: I am a high school student in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 我是台灣的高中生。

examples.en: I enjoy reading books on rainy days.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在下雨天看書。

examples.en: Can I ask you a quick question?
examples.zh: 我可以問你一個簡短的問題嗎？

examples.en: Nice to meet you.
examples.zh: 很高興認識你。

examples.en: Where did you buy that beautiful notebook?
examples.zh: 你在哪裡買那本漂亮的筆記本的？

examples.en: You can join our study group anytime.
examples.zh: 你隨時都可以加入我們的讀書會。

examples.en: He is my English teacher.
examples.zh: 他是我的英文老師。

examples.en: He plays soccer every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 他每個星期六早上都踢足球。

examples.en: He always helps his mother with the housework.
examples.zh: 他總是幫媽媽做家事。

examples.en: She lives in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她住在台北。

examples.en: She wants to be a doctor in the future.
examples.zh: 她未來想成為一名醫生。

examples.en: She speaks English very fluently.
examples.zh: 她的英語說得非常流利。

examples.en: It is a sunny day today.
examples.zh: 今天是個大晴天。

examples.en: I found my lost key; it was under the sofa.
examples.zh: 我找到遺失的鑰匙了，它在沙發下面。

examples.en: It takes only ten minutes to walk there.
examples.zh: 走路到那裡只要十分鐘。

examples.en: We take the MRT to school every day.
examples.zh: 我們每天搭捷運上學。

examples.en: We are going to have a picnic this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們這個週末打算去野餐。

examples.en: We should protect the environment together.
examples.zh: 我們應該一起保護環境。

examples.en: They are playing basketball in the park.
examples.zh: 他們正在公園打籃球。

examples.en: They arrived at the station on time.
examples.zh: 他們準時抵達車站。

examples.en: They are planning a surprise party for Amy.
examples.zh: 他們正在為艾咪籌辦一場驚喜派對。

examples.en: Ken is a very kind person.
examples.zh: 肯恩是一個非常善良的人。

examples.en: Only one person can enter the room at a time.
examples.zh: 一次只有一個人可以進入房間。

examples.en: She is the most hardworking person I know.
examples.zh: 她是我認識最努力認真的人。

examples.en: The tall man is our principal.
examples.zh: 那位高個子的男人是我們的校長。

examples.en: A young man helped the old lady cross the street.
examples.zh: 一位年輕男子幫忙老太太過馬路。

examples.en: That man works as an engineer at a tech company.
examples.zh: 那位男士在一間科技公司擔任工程師。

examples.en: That woman is wearing a beautiful dress.
examples.zh: 那位女士穿著一件漂亮的洋裝。

examples.en: A kind woman returned the lost wallet to the police station.
examples.zh: 一位好心的女士將遺失的皮夾送到警察局。

examples.en: She is a successful businesswoman in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她是台北一位成功的女性企業家。

examples.en: The little boy is playing with a toy car.
examples.zh: 那個小男孩正在玩玩具車。

examples.en: The boy won first prize in the speech contest.
examples.zh: 那個男孩在演講比賽中獲得第一名。

examples.en: Three boys are riding their bicycles by the riverside.
examples.zh: 三個男孩正在河濱騎腳踏車。

examples.en: The girl over there is my younger sister.
examples.zh: 在那邊的女孩是我妹妹。

examples.en: That smart girl solved the difficult math problem quickly.
examples.zh: 那個聰明的女孩很快解開了那道數學難題。

examples.en: Many little girls dream of becoming dancers.
examples.zh: 很多小女孩夢想成為舞者。

examples.en: Every child loves going to the night market.
examples.zh: 每個小孩子都喜歡逛夜市。

examples.en: The child fell asleep while listening to a bedtime story.
examples.zh: 那個孩子聽著床邊故事睡著了。

examples.en: Parents should spend more quality time with their child.
examples.zh: 父母應該多花有質量的時間陪伴孩子。

examples.en: Many people in Taiwan drink bubble tea.
examples.zh: 台灣有許多人喝珍珠奶茶。

examples.en: Hundreds of people gathered to watch the New Year fireworks.
examples.zh: 數百人聚集在一起看跨年煙火。

examples.en: Polite people always remember to say thank you.
examples.zh: 有禮貌的人總是記得說謝謝。

examples.en: She is my best friend in class.
examples.zh: 她是我班上最好的朋友。

examples.en: I made many new friends during summer camp.
examples.zh: 我在夏令營期間交了許多新朋友。

examples.en: A true friend will always stand by your side.
examples.zh: 真正的朋友總會站在你身邊支持你。

examples.en: What is your name?
examples.zh: 你的名字是什麼？

examples.en: Please write your name clearly on the test sheet.
examples.zh: 請在試卷上清楚寫下你的名字。

examples.en: They named their newborn daughter Emily.
examples.zh: 他們把剛出生的女兒命名為艾蜜莉。

examples.en: Mr. Lin is our new math teacher.
examples.zh: 林先生是我們的新數學老師。

examples.en: Mr. Brown will give a speech in the auditorium tomorrow.
examples.zh: 布朗先生明天將在禮堂發表演講。

examples.en: Excuse me, is Mr. Wang in his office right now?
examples.zh: 請問王先生現在在辦公室嗎？

examples.en: Mrs. Chen works at a bank.
examples.zh: 陳太太在一家銀行工作。

examples.en: Mrs. Smith baked some delicious cookies for the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 史密斯太太為鄰居烤了一些美味的手工餅乾。

examples.en: We bought some fresh vegetables from Mrs. Lee's farm stand.
examples.zh: 我們向李太太的農產攤位買了一些新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: Miss Wang will teach us art today.
examples.zh: 王小姐今天會教我們美術。

examples.en: Miss Davis is always patient with her young students.
examples.zh: 戴維斯小姐對她年幼的學生總是非常有耐心。

examples.en: I miss my childhood friends in my hometown.
examples.zh: 我很想念家鄉童年的朋友們。

examples.en: Please give this form to Ms. Huang.
examples.zh: 請把這份表格交給黃女士。

examples.en: Ms. Chang is the head manager of the sales department.
examples.zh: 張女士是業務部門的總主管。

examples.en: You can contact Ms. Taylor by email or phone.
examples.zh: 你可以透過電子郵件或電話聯絡泰勒女士。

examples.en: I have a warm and happy family.
examples.zh: 我有一個溫暖且幸福的家庭。

examples.en: My family usually gathers together on Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 我們全家通常在農曆新年團聚。

examples.en: Family is the most important thing in my life.
examples.zh: 家庭是我生命中最重要的事情。

examples.en: My father cooks delicious dinner for us.
examples.zh: 我父親為我們煮美味的晚餐。

examples.en: His father drives him to school every morning.
examples.zh: 他的父親每天早上開車送他上學。

examples.en: My father taught me how to ride a bicycle.
examples.zh: 我父親教我如何騎腳踏車。

examples.en: Her mother works as a nurse.
examples.zh: 她的母親擔任護理師。

examples.en: My mother always reminds me to eat more vegetables.
examples.zh: 我媽媽總是提醒我要多吃蔬菜。

examples.en: We gave mother a bouquet of flowers on Mother's Day.
examples.zh: 我們在母親節送了一束花給媽媽。

words.definition: 雙親之一；父母親（常用複數）

examples.en: My parents support my dream.
examples.zh: 我的父母支持我的夢想。

examples.en: Both of her parents are high school teachers.
examples.zh: 她的雙親都是高中老師。

examples.en: Being a good parent requires lots of patience and love.
examples.zh: 做一個稱職的父母需要很多的耐心與愛心。

examples.en: My elder brother is studying in college.
examples.zh: 我的哥哥正在念大學。

examples.en: I often play video games with my younger brother.
examples.zh: 我經常和我弟弟一起玩電動遊戲。

examples.en: Does your brother work in Taipei or Kaohsiung?
examples.zh: 你哥哥在台北還是高雄工作？

examples.en: I share a room with my sister.
examples.zh: 我和我妹妹共用一間房間。

examples.en: My elder sister helped me practice my English conversation.
examples.zh: 我姊姊幫我練習英語會話。

examples.en: Her little sister is starting kindergarten next week.
examples.zh: 她的小妹妹下週要開始上幼兒園了。

examples.en: They are very proud of their son.
examples.zh: 他們為自己的兒子感到非常驕傲。

examples.en: Mr. Wu took his son to the zoo last Sunday.
examples.zh: 吳先生上週日帶兒子去動物園。

examples.en: Their eldest son has graduated from medical school.
examples.zh: 他們的大兒子已經從醫學院畢業了。

examples.en: Their daughter loves reading comic books.
examples.zh: 他們的女兒喜歡看漫畫書。

examples.en: My daughter wants to learn how to play the piano.
examples.zh: 我的女兒想學彈鋼琴。

examples.en: They threw a lovely birthday party for their daughter.
examples.zh: 他們為女兒辦了一場溫馨可愛的生日派對。

examples.en: The baby is sleeping soundly in the crib.
examples.zh: 小嬰兒正在嬰兒床裡熟睡。

examples.en: Don't make loud noises or you will wake the baby.
examples.zh: 不要發出大聲音，否則你會吵醒小嬰兒。

examples.en: The baby took her very first steps yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 小寶寶昨天下午跨出了她的第一步。

examples.en: My grandfather goes for a walk every morning.
examples.zh: 我爺爺每天早上都會去散步。

examples.en: My grandfather loves telling stories about his youth.
examples.zh: 我爺爺喜歡講述他年輕時的故事。

examples.en: We celebrated my grandfather's eightieth birthday last month.
examples.zh: 我們上個月幫我爺爺慶祝了八十大壽。

examples.en: My grandmother makes the best dumplings.
examples.zh: 我奶奶包的水餃最好吃。

examples.en: I love spending weekends at my grandmother's house.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在奶奶家度過週末時光。

examples.en: My grandmother tends to her rooftop flower garden every day.
examples.zh: 我奶奶每天都在頂樓花園整理花草。

examples.en: Our English teacher is very patient.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師非常有耐心。

examples.en: A great teacher can inspire students to learn with passion.
examples.zh: 一位優秀的老師能激發學生充滿熱情地學習。

examples.en: She wants to be a history teacher after graduation.
examples.zh: 她畢業後想成為一名歷史老師。

examples.en: There are thirty students in our class.
examples.zh: 我們班上有三十位學生。

examples.en: Every student must hand in the homework before Friday.
examples.zh: 每位學生都必須在星期五前繳交功課。

examples.en: College students often join various clubs and activities.
examples.zh: 大學生通常會參加各式各樣的社團與活動。

examples.en: Amy is my favorite classmate.
examples.zh: 艾咪是我最喜歡的同班同學。

examples.en: I borrowed a math textbook from my classmate.
examples.zh: 我向我的同班同學借了一本數學課本。

examples.en: All of my classmates are friendly and helpful.
examples.zh: 我的同班同學都很友善且樂於助人。

examples.en: I walk to school every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上走路上學。

examples.en: Our school will hold an annual sports day next month.
examples.zh: 我們學校下個月將舉辦一年一度的運動會。

examples.en: What time does your school finish in the afternoon?
examples.zh: 你們學校下午幾點放學？

examples.en: Class begins at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 八點準時上課。

examples.en: Pay attention in class so you can get good grades.
examples.zh: 上課時要專心，才能拿到好成績。

examples.en: We have six classes every day from Monday to Friday.
examples.zh: 我們從星期一到星期五每天有六節課。

examples.en: Please keep the classroom clean and tidy.
examples.zh: 請保持教室乾淨整潔。

examples.en: The students hurried back to the classroom after the bell rang.
examples.zh: 鐘聲響起後，學生們匆忙跑回教室。

examples.en: There is an interactive digital whiteboard in our classroom.
examples.zh: 我們的教室裡有一塊互動式數位電子白板。

examples.en: Put your textbook on the desk.
examples.zh: 把你的課本放在書桌上。

examples.en: I always keep my study desk organized.
examples.zh: 我總是保持我的書桌井井有條。

examples.en: He found an old photograph inside his desk drawer.
examples.zh: 他在書桌抽屜裡找到了一張泛黃的舊照片。

examples.en: Please sit down on that wooden chair.
examples.zh: 請在那張木椅上坐下。

examples.en: There are not enough chairs for all the guests.
examples.zh: 沒有足夠的椅子給所有客人坐。

examples.en: He pulled out a chair and sat down next to me.
examples.zh: 他拉開一張椅子並坐在我身旁。

examples.en: I like to read a story book before bedtime.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在睡前讀故事書。

examples.en: Don't forget to book the train tickets in advance.
examples.zh: 不要忘記提前預訂火車票。

examples.en: This library contains thousands of rare English books.
examples.zh: 這座圖書館藏有數千本珍貴的英文書籍。

examples.en: Can I borrow your blue pen?
examples.zh: 我可以借你的藍色原子筆嗎？

examples.en: The black pen has run out of ink.
examples.zh: 那支黑色原子筆已經沒水了。

examples.en: Sign your signature here with this black ink pen.
examples.zh: 用這支黑墨水筆在這裡簽上你的名字。

examples.en: You need a 2B pencil for the test.
examples.zh: 你考試需要用 2B 鉛筆。

examples.en: Please sharpen your pencil before the examination starts.
examples.zh: 考試開始前請先把你的鉛筆削好。

examples.en: She drew a lovely cat sketch using a pencil.
examples.zh: 她用鉛筆畫了一幅可愛的貓咪素描。

examples.en: I lost my eraser under the desk.
examples.zh: 我的橡皮擦掉在桌子下了。

examples.en: Can I borrow your eraser to correct this mistake?
examples.zh: 我可以借你的橡皮擦來更正這個錯誤嗎？

examples.en: Make sure you bring a clean eraser to the exam.
examples.zh: 考試時務必帶一塊乾淨的橡皮擦。

examples.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
examples.zh: 用尺畫一條直線。

examples.en: She measured the length of the box with a thirty-centimeter ruler.
examples.zh: 她用一把三十公分的尺測量盒子的長度。

examples.en: The king was considered a wise ruler by his people.
examples.zh: 那位國王被人民視為一位英明的統治者。

examples.en: Put your homework in your school bag.
examples.zh: 把你的功課放進書包裡。

examples.en: She packed her travel bag for the weekend trip.
examples.zh: 她為週末旅行收拾了旅行提袋。

examples.en: Please don't forget to bring a reusable shopping bag.
examples.zh: 請不要忘記攜帶環保購物袋。

examples.en: My bedroom is clean and bright.
examples.zh: 我的臥室乾淨又明亮。

examples.en: Please make sure there is enough room for everyone to sit.
examples.zh: 請確保有足夠的空間讓大家坐下。

examples.en: We booked a comfortable hotel room near the train station.
examples.zh: 我們在火車站附近預訂了一間舒適的飯店房間。

examples.en: Dinner is ready on the table.
examples.zh: 晚餐已經在餐桌上準備好了。

examples.en: We reserved a table for four at the Italian restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在義大利餐廳預訂了一張四人桌。

examples.en: The report presents the experimental results in a clear table.
examples.zh: 報告在清楚的表格中呈現了實驗結果。

examples.en: Please close the door when you leave.
examples.zh: 離開時請關上門。

examples.en: Someone is knocking loudly on the front door.
examples.zh: 有人在前門大聲敲門。

examples.en: Remember to lock the door before you go to bed.
examples.zh: 睡覺前記得把門鎖上。

examples.en: Open the window to let fresh air in.
examples.zh: 打開窗戶讓新鮮空氣進來。

examples.en: The cat is sitting quietly by the living room window.
examples.zh: 貓咪安靜地坐在客廳窗戶旁。

examples.en: Raindrops are tapping gently against the bedroom window.
examples.zh: 雨滴輕輕敲打著臥室的窗戶。

examples.en: Our classroom is on the third floor.
examples.zh: 我們的教室在三樓。

examples.en: The wet floor is very slippery, so walk carefully.
examples.zh: 潮濕的地板非常滑，所以請小心行走。

examples.en: He dropped his glasses on the floor and broke them.
examples.zh: 他的眼鏡掉在地上摔破了。
